provenance: Questions in this file were adopted from the MIT-licensed project Onesayi/ccna-simulator at commit 6efca4f15e8ccf01fb44973b46bb26922797965a (Alistair Nhiwatiwa, 2026-10-04), originally authored against the CCNA v1.0 blueprint and re-keyed here to the v1.1 leaf objective IDs in src/data/objectives.json. The full per-question mapping, including every item dropped as out of scope and the reason, is in docs/ADOPTED.md. Each question records its origin in its `upstream` field. Distractor rationales are marked TODO and are written during Phase 2; no question ships without them.

questions.prompt: What does an 802.1Q trunk add to a frame, and how large is the VLAN ID field?

C.text: A 4-byte tag with a 12-bit VLAN ID

D.text: A 26-byte header with a 10-bit VLAN ID
D.rationale: TODO: explain why this is wrong

questions.explanation: The 802.1Q tag is 4 bytes: TPID 0x8100, then 3 PCP bits, 1 DEI bit and a 12-bit VID (0 to 4095, with 0 and 4095 reserved). The 26-byte header is ISL.

questions.prompt: A single large file transfer between two hosts crosses a four-link EtherChannel. How much of the bundle does it use?
